    """Return the cells hidden by the zero rectangle, recovered by horizontal reflection."""
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in zeros)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in zeros)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in zeros)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in zeros)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
